canonical_statement: For both real and complex scalars, every surjective bounded linear operator between Banach spaces is an open map.

expression_serialization.extraction: the text after the fully qualified declaration header in pinned Lean #print output, stripped only at both ends

domain_and_universes: Independent universes u and v; a closed conjunction of the Real and Complex cases; E : Type u and F : Type v; NormedAddCommGroup, same-field NormedSpace, and CompleteSpace structures on both E and F; target Prop in universe 0.
ordered_binders: f : E ->L[Real] F or f : E ->L[Complex] F
hypotheses: E and F are Banach spaces over the same selected scalar field, expressed by complete normed-space instances
f is an ordinary same-field ContinuousLinearMap, the bundled bounded linear operator
the coerced function f is surjective
conclusion: IsOpenMap f: for every open U : Set E, the image f '' U is open in F.
minimal_import_basis: This single direct import supplies the Real and Complex normed-field instances, complete-space and normed-space vocabulary, ContinuousLinearMap, IsOpenMap, and the needed topology. Deleting the sole import makes the module fail at unknown NormedAddCommGroup. No Banach/open-mapping proof module or aggregate Mathlib import is used.

checked_alternate_encodings.boundary: Definitionally expands IsOpenMap into the source definition that the image of every open set is open, without changing the scalar, completeness, operator, surjectivity, or binder scope.

uncredited_alternate_encodings: the stronger polymorphic semilinear target of ContinuousLinearMap.isOpenMap
RCLike-polymorphic or arbitrary nontrivially normed field formulations
LinearMap.range f = top instead of Function.Surjective f without a checked transport
controlled-preimage, local-ball, quotient-map, or bounded-inverse formulations

included: zero or trivial domain and codomain Banach spaces
the zero map onto a trivial codomain
noninjective surjective maps and quotient-type cases
all ordinary real and complex Banach spaces in independent universes
excluded: incomplete domain or codomain normed spaces
semilinear maps between distinct scalar fields
not_required: injectivity, finite dimensionality, separability, nontrivial carriers, or a nonzero operator
